title: The Veilwood
description: A forest that rearranges its paths for anyone who enters with a lie.

title: The Meridian Collegium
description: An ancient school built around a clock that measures impossible hours.

title: The Drowned Quarter

title: The Ashen Market
description: A market where people barter in secrets, unfinished dreams, and objects with uncertain histories.
